title: RsvpLink
description: A household's RSVP link (issue #30): the link's token is stored only as its SHA-256 hash. Kept twice, in the same shape: under the hash (to resolve a link) and under groupedKey(wedding_id, household_id) (the household's current link, so making a new one turns the old one off). Removed with the household.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

household_id.description: The household of the same wedding the link answers for.

token_hash.description: SHA-256 of the token, hex. The token itself is never stored.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the link was made, from the injected clock.
